items.title: Tiger Team Episode 1: The Car Dealership Takedown
items.description: S01E01: The team performs a security assessment of Symbolic Motors, an exotic car dealership near San Diego, CA. During recon they find the best entry point is a small skylight, dumpster dive to find the IT service company name, pose as customers to photograph cameras and motion sensors, then install a wireless camera watching the alarm keypad by posing as computer technicians. They enter through the skylight, disable building security with the recorded code, and drive off in a Lotus.

items.title: Tiger Team Episode 2: 24 Karat Caper
items.description: S01E02: The team breaks into an exclusive jeweler in Beverly Hills. During recon they pose as reporters from a celebrity magazine to get inside, then trick a secretary into inserting an infected USB drive which gives them remote access to private emails, financial records, and security codes. They social-engineer sensitive information from staff during a fake interview. To bypass the RFID-protected front door, a team member waves a portable RFID reader near the owner's wallet to clone his access card. After disabling a triggered alarm with the known security code, they crack the safe by guessing the owner's daughter's birthday and leave a polaroid of themselves wearing the diamonds.
